target_rationale: Two percentage points aggregate probability RMSE, with fixed family and device/family safeguards; exact marginalized targets remove test-shot luck.
worst_family_score_definition: minimum over families of 1 / (1 + family_mse / family_rmse_max[family]**2); higher is better
pass_rule: valid and core_score >= 0.5 and worst_family_score >= 0.5 and every device/family RMSE <= 0.040
memory_limit_semantics: RLIMIT_AS per process; not a total-RAM limit across the process tree
runtime_seconds_semantics: Evaluator validation and scoring time only; participant computation time is independently limited by the fresh-agent runner.
solvability_note: A private exact simulator validates labels, not recoverability. Its access to true parameters is not itself an achievable participant solution.
